name: ranch-snowy
description: Ranch, the snowy look (ROADMAP 49.10e): the shipped Ranch drawn again as a mountain snow barn: one great steep slate roof with kicked eaves over the aisle and stalls, a deep forebay before the doors with a hay gallery and hoist, pitching dormers, calcite and white birch gables; (II) a second steep gable for the feed and bunk wing with a stone storm porch, and a paddock with a lee wall and run-in shelter. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
